description:
The UAE Ministry of Finance issued Ministerial Decision No. 197 of 2026 (announced 19 Oct 2026, effective 1 Oct 2026), amending Ministerial Decision No. 243 of 2025 on the Electronic Invoicing System. Business transactions between members of the same Tax Group are treated as excluded transactions for 24 months starting 1 January 2027. E-invoices and e-credit notes no longer have to be stored inside the UAE - they must be kept for the period in the Tax Procedures Law and given to the FTA on request. The System Failure notice (within two business days) has been removed. Transactions outside the tax group are not covered by this exclusion; the 1 January 2027 start for businesses with revenue above AED 50 million is unchanged.

Sources (checked 17 Nov 2026):
- UAE Ministry of Finance - amends e-invoicing regulations (19 Oct 2026): https://mof.gov.ae/en/news/ministry-of-finance-amends-electronic-invoicing-regulations-to-ease-the-burden-on-businesses/
- WAM - Ministry of Finance amends electronic invoicing regulations: https://www.wam.ae/en/article/c2tl9em-ministry-finance-amends-electronic-invoicing
- The National (19 Oct 2026): https://thenationalnews.com/business/2026/10/19/uae-amends-e-invoicing-regulations-as-implementation-deadline-draws-closer
- UAE Ministry of Finance - 1 Jan 2027 start for revenue above AED 50 million: https://mof.gov.ae/en/news/ministry-of-finance-announces-targeted-amendments-to-einvoicing-system-decisions/

lines: If your U A E company is part of a V A T tax group, this e-invoicing change is for you.
Under Ministerial Decision one ninety seven of twenty twenty six, deals between members of the same tax group are excluded for twenty four months, from the first of January twenty twenty seven.

visual.title: Two more changes
items: Records can be stored outside the UAE
No more System Failure notice to the FTA

lines: Two more changes. E-invoices no longer have to be stored inside the U A E. Keep them for the period in the Tax Procedures Law, and share them with the F T A when asked.
And the rule to report a system failure to the F T A within two business days is gone.
But this covers only deals inside the group. The first of January start for businesses above fifty million dirhams has not changed, so map your intra-group invoices now.
